checked: The new branch and worktree must be absent; both immutable parent IDs and merge-base are checked. No existing checkout or foreign branch is reset, cleaned or forced.

All 12 left and221 right changed paths are disjoint; all17827 union leaves and six exact package trees are checked before commit; commit parent order and final tree are checked again before publication.

Sparse paths cover only chosen original instructions and four SDK packages. Capacity is measured from actual Git object sizes rounded to4KiB plus64MiB metadata allowance and512MiB remaining floor; root filesystem has its own128MiB minimum. No build/cache/account cleanup is performed.
The new no-checkout worktree is configured sparse then explicitly initialized with read-tree -m -u LEFT; existing and foreign worktrees are not materialized or altered.

Receipt O_EXCL claim is protected by receipt_claimed; claim failure never rewrites an older receipt. Each update uses unique same-directory tempfile.mkstemp, which is0600, followed by fdopen/fsync and replace of only this claimed receipt.

Foreign HEAD/status observations use --no-optional-locks, avoiding Git status index-refresh writes. A foreign owner may independently change its files; the script records equality rather than rolling anything back.
Only ordinary explicitly scoped commit:refs/heads/branch push is issued, with remote.origin.mirror=false and no force. Exact remote readback is required; failures leave owned state for inspection.
All published statuses remain source-only and do not claim SDK/paired runtime/consumer/Apple acceptance.
